classify_prompt_template.value:
Choose the skill that best matches the caller's message.
- Exactly one clear match: set skill_id; leave ambiguous_between empty.
- No match: leave both empty.
- Multiple plausible matches with no clear choice: leave skill_id empty and list their ids in ambiguous_between.

{skill_blocks}

Caller said: "{message_text}"
classify_prompt_template.description: Shared classify-stage prompt used by every agent's skill_router.route() to pick which skill applies to free text. Needs {skill_blocks} and {message_text} placeholders.

extract_prompt_template.value:
Extract the fields from the caller's message.
Use a listed default when the message does not specify a value.
Do not guess or invent values.

{field_lines}

Caller said: "{message_text}"
extract_prompt_template.description: Shared extract-stage prompt used by every agent's skill_router.route() to pull a matched skill's parameters from free text. Needs {field_lines} and {message_text} placeholders.

select_groups_prompt_template.description: Step 1 of tool_resolution.py's two-phase resolution - picks which registered tool group(s) apply to a question. Needs {question} and {listing} placeholders.

select_tool_call_answer_with_discoveries.value: Use a tool to get the requested value. A discovery only tells you where to look; it is not the answer. Do not describe the next step - call the tool. Use discovered database, collection, and field names; never guess them. Only finish when a tool result contains the requested value. Choose the tool and arguments that get closest to that value.
select_tool_call_answer_with_discoveries.description: select_tool_call's answer-eligibility instruction once at least one discovery exists. No placeholders.

select_tool_call_answer_cold_start.value: Nothing is known yet. Call the best tool to start finding the requested value. Choose the tool and arguments that get closest to the answer.
select_tool_call_answer_cold_start.description: select_tool_call's instruction on the very first attempt, before any discovery exists - deliberately omits mentioning 'answer' as an option at all. No placeholders.

select_tool_call_prompt_template.value:
Instruction: {question}

{discoveries_block}Available tools in group '{group_name}':
{listing}

{answer_instruction}

Rules:
- Use only the listed tools and their defined arguments.
- Never guess a database, collection, field, or ID.
- If one is unknown, discover it first.
- If the instruction names a person, agent, ID, or entity, filter by it.
- A schema sample shows field names, not the target entity's values.
- If a filter returns 0 results, retry with lowercase and underscores before concluding it is missing.
- Do not answer from discovery alone. Keep using tools until the requested value is retrieved.
select_tool_call_prompt_template.description: Step 2 of tool_resolution.py's two-phase resolution - picks a specific tool + arguments within one group. Needs {question}, {discoveries_block}, {group_name}, {listing}, and {answer_instruction} placeholders.

vision_classify_prompt.value:
Classify this image as exactly one:
- contact_card: WhatsApp contact card or phone-contact screenshot showing a person's name and phone number.
- knowledge_content: document, receipt, note, text screenshot, book page, whiteboard, or other useful content.
- unclear: anything else or not clear.
vision_classify_prompt.description: Vision-model classification of an incoming WhatsApp image (contact card / knowledge content / unclear). No placeholders.

vision_caption_prompt.value: Read this contact card. If a name and phone number are clearly visible, reply exactly: "Add <name> as a client, their number is <phone number>". Use only visible text. Otherwise reply exactly: NONE.
vision_caption_prompt.description: Extracts a name+phone caption from a contact-card image, or NONE. No placeholders.

chat_cache_relevance_prompt_template.description: Filters recent conversation turns down to the ones actually relevant to a new message. Needs {numbered} and {new_message} placeholders.
